Before you begin. If you want to keep your current strategy placement for reference, screenshot your Strategies tab (and Accounts tab) first. Then fully close NinjaTrader and the Vincere Ninja Manager before you run the installer, or it will warn you to close the manager.

The Vincere Ninja Manager often sits hidden in the system tray. Click the ^ ("show hidden icons") in the bottom-right of your taskbar, then right-click the Vincere Ninja Manager and choose Exit.

    One more check. Before running these tools, make sure both NinjaTrader and the Vincere Ninja Manager (in the system tray, under the ^) are fully closed. If you want your old strategy layout for reference, screenshot the Strategies tab first.
